findings.issue: The F0.2 snapshot omits issue #7's requirement that copied backups must not run independent sending workers at the same time, with deployment identity, root locking, and operating authority explicitly managed. Independent copies of the operations ledger can otherwise resend the same history.

The dependency diagram loses the r2 join between the Email MVP and #4 C4–C8 before #3. The delivery sequence no longer makes clear that both work streams join before scoring, while the Email MVP itself need not wait for the other providers.

The cross-platform deduplication summary omits r2's safeguards against deleting near-duplicate revisions or losing their separate time mappings, as well as the fact that transcript similarity cannot save the first ASR. Implementing the abbreviated plan could lose evidence or misstate savings.

summary: Restored the r2 plan's safeguards for copied sending ledgers and near-duplicate evidence, and clarified when parallel delivery work joins before scoring. Three new regression tests failed against the reviewed head and all seven roadmap tests now pass.
